title: introduce-adaptive-fidelity-curator-and-compact-failure-summarizer-ci-hook
author: Ethan Kim
release_notes: Add Adaptive Fidelity Curator CI hook that dynamically reweights prompt-set items based on short-term fidelity drift and a Compact Failure Summarizer that generates actionable regression scopes. Backfill job and docs included.
description: Motivation: Our existing CI smokechecks treat every prompt in a prompt-set equally which leads to noisy failures when a small subset of high-variance prompts trigger alerts. This PR introduces two coordinated pieces: (1) Adaptive Fidelity Curator: a CI hook that assigns per-prompt fidelity weights using an exponential-moving-average of recent evaluation scores and token-level stability signals, and exposes a soft-fail gating policy that scales alert severity by weighted SLO violations; (2) Compact Failure Summarizer: a post-failure analyzer that clusters failing examples by semantic/diff similarity, extracts exemplars, and produces a one-page failure summary with suggested roll-back scope (prompt IDs or prompt-cohort) for on-call triage. Changes in this PR are intended to reduce noisy alerts, prioritize high-impact regressions, and provide engineers with an immediate, digestible failure digest. Checklist: - [x] Implement Adaptive Fidelity Curator hook with EWMA weighting and cohort windowing - [x] Implement Compact Failure Summarizer using hierarchical clustering + diff compression - [x] Unit tests for weighting, gating, and summarizer outputs - [x] Add e2e smoke CI job wiring + sample prompt-set - [x] Update docs/ci_hooks.md and examples - [x] Add backfill job to compute initial fidelity baselines for existing prompt-sets - [x] Performance benchmarks for hook overhead (avg + p95 latency) Design notes: The curator maintains a sliding window of the last N CI runs per prompt (configurable; default N=30). For each prompt we compute a fidelity score f in [0,1] combining: normalized metric delta (metric-specific, e.g., exact-match/ROUGE) and token-stability score (1 - normalized edit distance across model outputs). We then compute an EWMA: w_t = alpha * f_t + (1-alpha) * w_{t-1}, alpha configurable per workspace. Per-prompt weights are normalized across the prompt-set and used to compute a weighted SLO breach score. Gate policy supports: hard-fail on weighted breach > T_hard, soft-fail (notify but don't block) on T_soft < weighted breach < T_hard, and auto-escalation if breach persists for M consecutive runs. Compact Failure Summarizer works after a CI failure: it vectorizes failing outputs using the eval-harness sentence-embedder (existing infra), clusters with average-linkage, selects top-k exemplars per cluster (k configurable), and produces a markdown summary with cluster descriptions, representative diffs, frequency, and a suggested scope for rollback. Small on-disk summarizer sample (embedded in tests) compresses diffs with a 3-line context window to keep summaries brief. Backfill: a job to run the curator against historical eval traces to seed initial weights. It runs as a separate scheduled job and writes fidelity baselines to the prompt-set metadata store. Safety and opt-outs: hooks are opt-in per-repo/prompt-set and respect existing ignore-lists and label overrides. Notably this PR does not change any default hard-blocking behavior unless the workspace enables weighted gating. Related work: ENG-4219 (fidelity-weighting design doc), ENG-4302 (CI alert noise audit). Commits summary: - 9a3b2c1 implement adaptive fidelity curator core with ewma and windowing - f4d2a10 add compact failure summarizer and clustering util - b7e5c33 wire hook into ci-pipeline and add e2e smoke job - c1f0a9d add backfill job + migration to write baseline weights - 2e8b5f7 tests: unit + integration + perf harness - 3d4c2b1 docs: ci_hooks.md + examples + config reference - a7c9e88 linting and minor refactors Files changed (high-level): - src/hooks/adaptive_fidelity.py - src/hooks/compact_failure_summarizer.py - src/ci/pipelines/weighted_eval_pipeline.yaml - scripts/backfill/seed_fidelity_baselines.py - tests/unit/test_adaptive_fidelity.py - tests/integration/test_weighted_gate_e2e.py - docs/ci_hooks.md Notes on implementation: adaptive_fidelity.py is ~420 lines; core algorithm is implemented with a small in-memory ring buffer and a pluggable metric adapter so new metrics can be added per-prompt-set. The weighted gate adds ~20ms p95 overhead to the existing smokecheck run (measured in perf harness) and is configurable to run in a 'dry-run' mode which computes weights and logs decisions without affecting CI outcomes. Example gating config snippet included in docs (simplified): "gate: { mode: weighted, alpha: 0.15, window: 30, thresholds: { soft: 0.08, hard: 0.18 }, escalation_runs: 3 }" Tests and CI: Unit tests added for EWMA math, normalization, and cluster exemplar selection. Integration test simulates a prompt-set with a mix of flaky/high-variance prompts and validates that the weighted gate reduces false-positive hard-fails by ~42% in the simulated workload. Performance test asserts the hook adds <50ms median overhead under default config. Logging and telemetry: curator emits per-run aggregated metrics (fidelity_weight_distribution, weighted_breach_score, gate_decision) to the existing metric namespace eval.harness.curator. Summarizer logs cluster counts and exemplar IDs to the event store for postmortem linking. Docs: docs/ci_hooks.md updated with configuration, opt-in instructions, and examples for rollout. Migration/backfill: seed_fidelity_baselines.py will be run once by infra after merging; it includes a dry-run mode to preview changes. Rollout plan: - Week 0: merge to main, feature flag off - Week 1: enable dry-run for all workspaces to gather baselines - Week 2: opt-in pilot on two high-volume prompt-sets - Week 4: measure alert noise reduction and toggle weighted gating on by default for pilot repos if results are positive Rollout risks and mitigations: risk: underweighted rare but critical prompts may be deprioritized. mitigation: we add an override list that marks prompts as critical and pins their weight above a floor. risk: clustering could group distinct failure modes together. mitigation: summarizer exposes cluster isolation metrics and a human-in-the-loop re-cluster button in the failure UI. Response: "Increased job retries and added stronger timeouts to the e2e harness (commit b7e5c33)." CI summary: - build: pass - unit-tests: pass - integration-e2e: pass after rerun (one flaky timeout on first run) - lint: pass - coverage: 82% (new code covered at 88%) Merge outcome: Squash and merge to main on 2025-01-29 by Priya Natarajan. Post-merge actions: - infra to schedule backfill (task ENG-4401) - enable dry-run across org by default (feature flag: curator.dry_run=true) - monitor metric eval.harness.curator.weighted_breach_score for one week and report in ENG-xxx triage Slack channel. If problems surface, revert plan: set curator.enabled=false at workspace level. This PR is intentionally opt-in and non-breaking.
